adds.title: Vermont conversion therapy ban - Vermont Senate / House / Governor Peter Shumlin
adds.summary: Vermont enacted S.132 (Act 138) signed May 25, 2016 prohibiting conversion therapy on minors and treating its performance on minors as unprofessional conduct under 18 V.S.A. §§ 8351-8353 and related 26 V.S.A. licensing statutes.

adds.title: Vermont birth certificate and driver's license gender marker laws - Vermont General Assembly / Governor Phil Scott / Department of Motor Vehicles / Department of Health
adds.summary: Vermont enacted H.628 as Act 88, approved April 6, 2022, amending 18 V.S.A. § 5112 to allow issuance of a new birth certificate to reflect gender identity.
